newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end lower on S&P rating, rise in swap rates.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end lower on S&P rating, rise in swap rates.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGB futures ended sharply lower after S&P assigned Bpi rating to three Japanese life insurers. Rating led to speculation that BOJ may raise rates to help life insurers secure greater investment returns, traders said.
*Rise in medium-term IRS rates also invited selling.
